# Plan for ISSUE-194

Scope developer and tester test execution through prompt guidance, with regression coverage for repository, embedded, and scaffolded copies.

**Shape: Routine.** The conflicting instructions are localized to four prompt files; existing harness tests provide the synchronization pattern.

## What we know

- Developer contract item 5 currently requires every trusted check; its PR revision paragraph also says to run required checks (`.swarm/prompts/developer.md:11`, `:26`). The embedded copy repeats both instructions (`internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/developer.md`).
- Tester contract item 2 currently requests approved validation commands, while item 3 already preserves provisional VALIDATION.md output and coordinator authority (`.swarm/prompts/tester.md:7`). The embedded tester copy matches.
- `TestDeveloperOutputInstructionsAndPromptSync` compares normalized repository/template bytes and checks scaffolded output (`internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go:11`). There is no equivalent tester sync coverage in this file.
- `TestShippedPRRevisionPrompts` expects the developer revision text to contain “required checks” (`internal/harness/scaffold_test.go:1099`); keep that phrase while assigning those checks to the coordinator.
- Import policy permits developer IMPLEMENTATION.md and tester VALIDATION.md separately (`internal/workflow/import_policy.go:25`). The coordinator calls validation.Validate and RecordTrustedValidation after the tester (`internal/workflow/engine.go:1080`). Existing import and trusted-validation tests cover these boundaries.
- `make check` runs formatting inspection, vet, staticcheck, and one race-enabled full suite (`Makefile`, targets lint, race, check).

## What we're assuming

No runtime change is needed: this WorkUnit changes agent instructions, not test selection machinery. Check this by reviewing the final diff: only the four prompts, harness regression test, and changelog fragment should change.

## Open questions

No design questions block implementation. Whether the final `make check` passes is answered by the tester's single final run; environmental failures must be recorded rather than hidden by repeated suite runs.

## Implementation sequence and exact touchpoints

1. Update `.swarm/prompts/developer.md` and `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/developer.md` identically. Replace the all-checks demand with: the coordinator reruns every required check; run TEST_PLAN.md commands and targeted changed-package tests first; run the full suite at most once, at the end, only if TEST_PLAN.md requires it. Avoid automatic reruns without changed code, a failure to investigate, or an unresolved concern. Align the task-snapshot and PR-revision paragraphs with this policy so they do not reintroduce blanket check execution. Preserve IMPLEMENTATION.md output ownership and other contract requirements.
2. Apply the same execution policy to `.swarm/prompts/tester.md` and `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/tester.md`. Preserve reporting of failures/unverified criteria and provisional VALIDATION.md output; state explicitly that the tester verdict is advisory and the coordinator independently reruns every required check and writes the authoritative report. Preserve credential and claim-bound command restrictions.
3. In `internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go`, retain `TestDeveloperOutputInstructionsAndPromptSync` and add `TestWorkerTestScopeInstructionsAndPromptSync`, table-driven over developer/tester. Compare repository and embedded prompt bytes with CRLF normalization, initialize a temporary scaffold using InitRepository, and check scaffolded bytes match the template. Assert both roles retain all four execution requirements (coordinator checks, plan commands, changed-package tests first, conditional single final full suite). Assert tester advisory status and VALIDATION.md reporting. These assertions must fail against the old prompts. Preserve existing output ownership assertions and existing import-policy/trusted-validation tests unchanged.
4. Add `changes/unreleased/194-scoped-agent-tests.md` with one human-readable bullet describing scoped developer/tester test runs and coordinator verification.
5. Follow TEST_PLAN.md. Developer records targeted results in IMPLEMENTATION.md; tester records verification and the single final make check result in VALIDATION.md. The coordinator independently executes its approved required checks.

No changes to validator policy, workflow authority, import logic, slash-command templates, or other harness instructions are planned. Extending the existing focused prompt test is preferable to adding runtime test-selection machinery, which is outside the objective.

## Operator guidance

> Developer: record notes in .swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: record results in .swarm/active/VALIDATION.md. Both: the coordinator reruns every required check; run targeted tests (-run, single packages) and at most one full-suite run at the end.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->

# Test plan for ISSUE-194

The coordinator reruns every approved required check. Agents run the focused commands below first. This plan requires exactly one final full-suite invocation, `make check`, assigned to the tester. Developer must not also run go test ./..., go test -race ./..., or make check. Do not repeat passing commands without a relevant change or unresolved concern. No tests are required during planning.

## Acceptance mapping

| Acceptance criterion | Verification |
| --- | --- |
| Developer/tester repository and template prompts explain coordinator checks, prioritize TEST_PLAN.md and changed-package tests, and permit at most one final full suite only when the plan requires it; copies stay synchronized | Add TestWorkerTestScopeInstructionsAndPromptSync in internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go. Exercise both roles, normalized repository/template equality, scaffold/template equality, and each execution-policy clause. Run the focused harness command below. Review developer snapshot/revision text for conflicting all-checks instructions. |
| Tester still writes VALIDATION.md and has an advisory verdict; existing import-policy and trusted-validation tests unchanged | New prompt test asserts tester reporting and advisory/coordinator authority text. Run unchanged workflow/import and lease/trusted-validation tests below. Review changed paths to confirm these tests and production authority code remain untouched. |
| make check passes | Tester runs make check once, last, after targeted checks and any fixes. Record its exit status and observed failures in VALIDATION.md. |

The required changelog fragment must exist at changes/unreleased/194-scoped-agent-tests.md with one `- ` bullet.

## Developer: targeted verification

After editing, format only the changed Go test file:

```bash
gofmt -w internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go
go test ./internal/harness -run 'Test(WorkerTestScopeInstructionsAndPromptSync|DeveloperOutputInstructionsAndPromptSync|DeveloperSnapshotInstructions|ShippedPRRevisionPrompts|DeveloperChangelogInstructions)$' -count=1
```

Demonstrate that the new regression assertions reject the old instruction text, using a temporary local restoration or equivalent isolated fixture, then restore the intended prompts. Never edit approved plan inputs. Run the changed package once after the final edits:

```bash
go test ./internal/harness
```

Record commands, outcomes, and any blockers in `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md`. Keep `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md` for the tester.

## Tester: boundary verification, then one final check

Review IMPLEMENTATION.md and the final changed files. Reuse successful unchanged-package evidence; rerun the focused harness command only if developer evidence is missing, files changed afterward, or a specific concern needs verification. Run these existing boundary tests without modifying them:

```bash
go test ./internal/workflow -run 'Test(WritableImportPolicy|WritableImportPolicyUsesTrustedPatterns|TesterReadsApprovedInputs)$' -count=1
go test ./internal/lease -run 'Test(TrustedValidationCannotBeImported|GatewayValidationCannotGainReuseAuthority)$' -count=1
```

Finally, run the sole agent full-suite command:

```bash
make check
```

This includes go vet ./..., go tool staticcheck ./..., formatting inspection, and go test -race ./.... Do not add another full-suite run. If it fails, report the failure and use targeted commands to diagnose/verify fixes; the coordinator will rerun every required check. Record actual results, unresolved failures, and any unverified acceptance criteria in `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md`; the tester report remains advisory. Do not invoke claim-bound validation or request coordinator credentials.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> Developer: record notes in .swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: record results in .swarm/active/VALIDATION.md. Both: the coordinator reruns every required check; run targeted tests (-run, single packages) and at most one full-suite run at the end.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->

# Review of ISSUE-194 plan

The approach is right and correctly sized as Routine: change the four prompts, add a sync test, and add a changelog fragment. But the plan misses an existing test and a doc line that its own change would break, and both conflict with the WorkUnit and the quality bar. Its claim that "only the four prompts, harness regression test, and changelog fragment should change" is therefore wrong.

## Audit

| Item | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Objective: dev/tester prompts in both copies use TEST_PLAN.md and changed-package tests, with at most one final full suite | Covered | Plan steps 1–2. Today the repo and template copies match byte for byte (`diff` is clean). |
| Out of scope: validator required checks and which verdict counts | Respected | No runtime, import-policy or validator changes planned. |
| Constraint: allow_harness_changes | Satisfied | WorkUnit sets `true`; `.swarm/prompts/**` edits are authorized. |
| Constraint: changelog fragment | Covered | `changes/unreleased/194-scoped-agent-tests.md`, one `- ` bullet. |
| AC1: prompt content plus a sync test | Partially covered | New table-driven test is good. **But `TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions` is not addressed** (finding 1). |
| AC2: tester still writes VALIDATION.md, verdict advisory, import and trusted-validation tests unchanged | Covered | Cited tests exist (`internal/workflow/import_policy_test.go:18,128,214`; `internal/lease/validation_reuse_test.go:11,50`). Import policy (`import_policy.go:25`) and `engine.go` Validate/RecordTrustedValidation flow verified. |
| AC3: make check passes | At risk | It would fail on finding 1 as planned. One final run by the tester is appropriate. |
| Shape and evidence | Mostly OK | Evidence is real, but line numbers are off: the developer all-checks item is `developer.md:10` (not 11) and PR revision is `:24` (not 26). Tester item 3 is `tester.md:8`. Minor; please correct. |
| Docs accuracy (goals invariant) | Missing | See finding 2. |
| Test-run economy (operator guidance) | Good | Developer runs targeted tests plus one package run. Tester runs the boundary tests plus a single `make check`. |

## Required revisions

1. **Handle `TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions` (`internal/harness/scaffold_test.go:1229-1243`).** This test asserts that the generated developer prompt contains `"run every command in the trusted required checks"`, `"Fix lint and format findings"` and `"rather than leaving them for CI"`. Plan step 1 removes the first phrase, so this test fails and so does `make check`. The plan must say whether to update or replace this assertion: the WorkUnit only freezes the import-policy and trusted-validation tests, so updating it is allowed. Add the touchpoint to the implementation sequence and to "What we're assuming". Add `DeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions` to the developer's focused `-run` regex in TEST_PLAN.md.
2. **Update `docs/developer.md:321`.** It says: "Run every required check before you finish… The shipped developer prompt asks agents to do the same." After this change, that sentence misstates the shipped prompt, which breaks the docs-accuracy invariant. Reword it to match the new policy: the coordinator reruns required checks, agents run TEST_PLAN.md and changed-package tests, and agents fix format and lint findings on their changed code. Add the file to the touchpoints.
3. **State the lint and format expectation explicitly.** Removing "run every required check" must not also drop the developer's duty to fix gofmt/vet/staticcheck findings. Otherwise the coordinator's first failing check becomes the developer's feedback loop, which is the slow path this WorkUnit wants to avoid. Say that the prompt keeps "Fix lint and format findings yourself rather than leaving them for CI", scoped to changed packages (for example `gofmt -s -l` on changed files, `go vet ./<pkg>`). Have the new test or the updated test from item 1 assert it.

## Non-blocking

- Fix the line citations listed above.
- Keep the phrase "required checks" in the PR-revision paragraph so `TestShippedPRRevisionPrompts` still passes. The plan already notes this.
- `docs/developer.md:333-336` already describes the validator's changed-package pass. Linking to it from the 321 rewrite would explain why agents need not repeat the full suite.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> Developer: record notes in .swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: record results in .swarm/active/VALIDATION.md. Both: the coordinator reruns every required check; run targeted tests (-run, single packages) and at most one full-suite run at the end.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->
